passed: The Reno trigger is a native button, so Enter and Space activate it through its click handler; it also opens on mouse or pen hover.

The trigger exposes expanded state and controls, and the panel is hidden when closed. Focus stays on the trigger when opened; Tab can reach the Play and Close buttons, the player, and the YouTube link.
The trigger receives a visible focus style. The Close button returns focus to the trigger when focus was inside the panel.
notes: Reno is generated for marked introduction text in both the home template and bio partial. For New York, keep activation available without hover: use a native button that supports click, Enter, and Space, with visible focus and a reachable Close control.

The Escape handler listens on the parent document and cannot receive key events while focus is inside the cross-origin YouTube iframe. The existing Close button remains available before the iframe, but embedded-player keyboard behavior was not runtime-tested; verify Tab can leave the player.
